title: From Anger to steadier practice
subtitle: For when anger keeps steering the day
description: Follow heat from the mouth back to the wound beneath it, then stay long enough for force to give way to steadier truth.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Anger is met at the mouth and turned back toward steadiness.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before the next hard reply, slow the tongue and give the heat one more breath.
